affected_locations: Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station, Japan
key_impacts: Accident damaged Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station Units 1–4, triggering a long-term decommissioning effort.
Generation of contaminated water remains a critical challenge for sustainable decommissioning.
About 1,100,000 m3 of ALPS-treated water was stored on-site as of October 2018.
Fuel debris was identified in Units 1–3, requiring investigation and retrieval planning.
Spent fuel removal is required from Units 1–3, with preparations advanced for Unit 3.
